checks.name: all four KID quadratic necessary charges

mode_statement: Full normalized Wigner j=3/2 block. Example excites left m=+3/2 and its real-field conjugate m=-3/2; all right indices and metric components produced by the reduction are retained.
scope: Nontrivial smooth linear finite-time solution with all four quadratic KID necessary conditions. No nonlinear lift or horizon/long-time stability claim.
